# Project guidance

- Keep the interface in Spanish and preserve the responsive, accessible visual system.
- Treat all support, directory, and emergency information as local data requiring verification before publication.
- Never imply that this prototype provides live support, secure storage, encryption, or deletion of browser history.
- Do not add persistence or transmit personal data from demonstration forms.
- Run `npm run build` after code changes.

## Setup checklist

- [x] Verify project requirements and scaffold React, TypeScript, and Vite.
- [x] Customize the app for the requested support and autonomy workflows.
- [x] No additional VS Code extensions are required.
- [x] Compile the project with the production build.
- [x] Use the Vite development server for local preview.
- [x] Document setup and prototype limitations in README.md.
